title: Pathology Randomization for Synthetic Priors and Zero-Shot Detection
abstract: arXiv:2611.21975v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hospital brain imaging archives hold a diverse array of pathology at sample sizes beyond prospective studies, particularly for underrepresented populations and diseases. To unlock uncurated clinical data and scale analysis, methods are needed to detect abnormalities across contrasts and resolutions. Synthetic data has provided robust, contrast-agnostic models for a variety of human neuroimaging tasks in healthy anatomy, but pathology detection and other tasks in clinical settings still require real patient data, contrast-specific models, or disease-specific generators. We propose PathoDraw, a generative model of brain MRI with pathology. A conditional distribution of lesions given the healthy anatomy is drawn into the label map before contrast-agnostic rendering, and a single network estimates healthy anatomy with exact signed intensity deviation of any input scan. translated_title: 用于合成先验与零样本检测的病理随机化方法
translated_abstract: 医院脑成像档案库中保存着远超前瞻性研究规模的多样化病理样本，尤其涵盖代表性不足的人群和疾病。为了充分利用未经整理的临床数据并扩大分析规模，需要能够跨对比度和分辨率检测异常的方法。合成数据已为健康解剖结构的多种人类神经影像任务提供了鲁棒的、与对比度无关的模型，但病理检测以及临床环境中的其他任务仍需依赖真实患者数据、对比度特定模型或疾病特定生成器。我们提出PathoDraw，一种包含病理的脑部MRI生成模型。在与对比度无关的渲染之前，将基于健康解剖结构的病灶条件分布绘制到标签图中，并由单一网络结合输入扫描的精确带符号强度偏差来估计健康解剖结构。该与对比度无关的3D UNet在病灶条件下学习健康标签……
tldr: 该论文提出PathoDraw，一种通过在对比度无关渲染前将病灶条件分布随机绘制到标签图中的脑部MRI生成模型，从而无需真实患者数据即可实现病理合成先验与零样本异常检测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes PathoDraw, a generative model of pathological brain MRI that randomizes lesion distributions into label maps before contrast-agnostic rendering, enabling synthetic pathology priors and zero-shot abnormality detection without requiring real patient data.
